reviews.comment: Dr. Howard was a good professor. Going to the MATH200 lectures were practically necessary if you want to complete any of the assignments. If you miss one, you won't have a clue what to do, so make a friend for notes you may have missed. Overall, challenging yet rewarding class with a helpful professor.

Took this Fall 2022. The homework was really easy. It was partner work and an extension of what we learned in class. I think that the class was a great intro intro what a math major is like. I am very thankful I took this class.

One of the best professors I've ever had. The notes I took off his lectures were the best notes I've taken. Very little homework, but provides a lot of practice problems that I would do. The exams were very similar to what I did on the homework and practice. I wouldn't miss a lecture though since the book isn't the best.

The class is graded mostly by the three exams you have (2 midterms, 1 final). He gives practice problems as homework (dont get turned in/graded), and 3 question take-home quizzes every week. For exams, the practice problems and quizzes are great review. Go to his lecture because he moves quickly. No calculators or cheat sheets for the exam.

It isn't as difficult as some make it seem. He goes in-depth with the material so if you forget something you can derive equations by yourself if need be. HW/Quizzes can sometimes be difficult. The Exam Reviews help you before the exams as long as you keep practicing the problems. He is very knowledgeable and sometimes helps with HW! 10/10 prof :)

The way he runs this course is more tough than it should be. Has a "remember everything" attitude and with the absolute volume of methods in Differential Equations this guarantees you will not ace a thing. The course is graded by only tests and barely HW, so if you don't have unfair amounts of crunch time above others choose a different professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In my opinion Dr. Howard was a great professor who really cares about his students' success. He had office hours everyday that there wasn't class and would even stay up to an hour after class to help his students solve some tricky problems. He truly shows what it means to be a great professor, because he will do anything to make sure you succeed.

In my opinion this was not a very difficult class. Howard explains things very clearly and his grading expectations are listed out. He is available for LOTS of office hours and that helped a ton on homework and python assignments. Very reasonable guy

Dr. Howard is the goat. If you pay attention in lecture and attend office hours for extra help, this class will be fairly easy. Putting in the work will pay off. He is a very understanding guy and is sympathetic to personal matters. Take Dr. Howard if you want a prof that cares about his students and truly wants them to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Howard was by far the best Professor Ive ever had. Differential equations is a tough class, but he made it easy to understand. Very accessible outside of class and very willing to provide outside help. He gives practice tests that are very similar to the real ones. Cares more about his students than any other professor. He loves questions.

He's really nice, he's just not great at explaining concepts. The first test was fine but the second test was really hard. At least 2 homework assignments every week and we had python assignments that no other profs gave to their kids (these were also insanely hard and no one knew how to do them).
